sentences.text: At its November 12, 2026 meeting, the Council passed Ordinance 260951 (an ordinance is a city law) on the Port Authority loan.
The Council passed Ordinance 260711, a one-year contract renewal with LAZ Parking Midwest, LLC in the amount of $1,942,859.
It passed Ordinance 260970, which estimates $1,000,000.00 in contributions from Jackson County and appropriates $1,000,000.00 in the Capital Improvements Sales Tax Fund.
The Council passed Ordinance 260954, which accepts a $49,000.00 grant and appropriates $49,000.00 in Fund 2580.
It passed Ordinance 260924 on the 47th and Broadway Tax Increment Financing Plan, with Willett voting Nay.
Ordinance 260940 on the Denali III, LLC industrial development plan was held on docket.
